name: ribbon-blossoms
description: Blossoms folded from blue and cyan satin ribbon on Daylight; the left half stays clear for text.
prompt: Five flowers made from folded glossy satin ribbon: each blossom's petals are loops of ribbon in electric blue and luminous cyan, with deep navy stems, arranged in a loose diagonal from the lower right on a pale daylight ground. Studio product photography, crisp soft shadows falling to the lower right, the left half left almost empty. Colour palette strictly limited to deep navy #121B2A, electric blue #1B56FF, luminous cyan #00D5FF and pale daylight #F4F7FB, with their in-between shades. Premium, calm editorial brand imagery with generous negative space and soft light from the upper left. No text, letters, numbers, logos, people, robots, circuit patterns, sparkles, purple or pink.
